en.get_research_context: Start here when creating or editing research. Read current data readiness, authoring constraints, a documentation guide and one folder page. Read get_authoring_reference for complete formula syntax and Python SDK semantics; use get_alpha_catalog for available fields and functions. Constraints include executable Direct/Framework templates. Diagnose the complete configuration with diagnose_research_spec before submitting. Follow folders.next_cursor with folder_cursor; folder_limit defaults to 20, at most 50.
en.get_authoring_reference: Read the current authoring contract without creating research or requiring a ready Dataset. topic selects workflow, formula, python_sdk or examples. Omit symbol for the topic overview and member index; pass an exact indexed symbol for its full signature, parameters, behavior, object fields and examples. Unknown symbols return found=false with the index, never guessed APIs. Read relevant entries before writing unfamiliar formulas or Python. Use get_alpha_catalog for currently available fields/functions, then diagnose_research_spec for the complete configuration.
en.get_alpha_catalog: Find available Alpha fields and functions before writing a formula or requesting Python history. Set kind=fields or functions to browse separately; query searches identifiers, field IDs and descriptions by case-insensitive substring. identifiers selects exact names; filters intersect. Fields precede functions in identifier order. The combined limit defaults to 20, at most 50. Follow next_cursor with cursor and unchanged filters. Use field.identifier in formulas and field.field_id in Data.history. Read get_authoring_reference for formula syntax and Python SDK semantics.
en.diagnose_alpha_formula: Diagnose an expression in signal or exposure context without creating a Run. Exposure accepts constants or common daily numeric expressions, producing 0 to 1; stock fields, cross-sectional rank and account state are not allowed.
en.diagnose_research_spec: Validate a complete research configuration against current data, expression dependencies and execution budget. Creates no Run or data reservation. Submission revalidates independently; this is not a capacity reservation.
en.list_research_runs: Find, filter or rank owned ResearchRuns. Filtering and numeric ordering apply to all matches before pagination; use this for keyword lookup and top-N queries. For strategy rankings set research_kind=strategy_backtest, status=succeeded and an explicit sort metric. All metric conditions are AND; 0.20 means 20%. Missing metrics sort last and are not valid ranked values. Results include compact metrics, comparison dates and Universe; read details only for selected IDs. Pages may contain fewer than limit rows due to byte budget; follow next_cursor with unchanged query fields until enough valid rows are collected or the list ends. Pages are a live view, not a frozen snapshot. Requires research:read; reading never creates or reruns research.
en.get_research_run: Poll one durable ResearchRun without embedding its Result; requires research:read and may recommend a retry delay while work is active.
en.get_research_run_result: Read one bounded semantic Result section from a succeeded ResearchRun; collection sections use stable pagination and require research:read. Strategy event sections expose targets, orders, child orders, fills and valuation adjustments, with supported date/instrument/parent-ID filters and at most 50 rows. Cash reconciles using Research Settlement, not raw notional. not_recorded differs from a recorded empty page. daily_holdings_status lists independent retention units without renewing. daily_holdings requires an explicit unit_id and accepts date/instrument filters. Each page scans at most eight partitions; an empty page with next_cursor has not finished scanning. Each successful detail read renews only that unit for seven days. Expired/not_recorded differs from a recorded empty account; no automatic rerun occurs. Holdings cursors remain on their original source. Large sections return result_page: continue this tool with section=result_page, query=original arguments and result_cursor=next_result_cursor. Concatenate json_fragment in offset order and verify checksum_sha256 before parsing the complete JSON.
en.list_daily_tracks: List durable DailyTracks newest first with stable opaque pagination; requires tracking:read and returns compact summaries only.
en.get_daily_track: Poll one durable DailyTrack lifecycle, progress, action eligibility, timing, block reason, and available result sections; requires tracking:read and embeds no observations, positions, or checkpoints.
en.get_daily_track_result: Read one bounded semantic DailyTrack Result section from its current immutable checkpoint; observations and origin positions use stable opaque pagination and require tracking:read. Strategy event sections page targets, orders, child orders, fills and valuation adjustments with supported date/instrument/parent-ID filters and at most 50 rows. Event cursors pin their publication across Refresh; restart without a cursor to see newly published events. daily_holdings_status lists independent retention units without renewing. daily_holdings requires an explicit unit_id and accepts date/instrument filters. Each page scans at most eight partitions; an empty page with next_cursor has not finished scanning. Each successful detail read renews only that unit for seven days. Expired/not_recorded differs from a recorded empty account; no automatic rerun occurs. Holdings cursors remain on their original source. Large sections return result_page: continue this tool with section=result_page, query=original arguments and result_cursor=next_result_cursor. Concatenate json_fragment in offset order and verify checksum_sha256 before parsing the complete JSON.
en.start_daily_track: Start one durable DailyTrack from a succeeded Strategy Backtest; requires tracking:execute, is non-destructive and idempotent by request_id, and continues after the MCP connection closes. Rejects non-succeeded or non-Strategy origins, duplicate origins, and full active capacity as state conflicts. After acceptance, poll get_daily_track after retry_after_seconds.
en.refresh_daily_track: Queue one explicit advance of an active, lagging, idle DailyTrack to the latest available Dataset Head; requires tracking:execute, is non-destructive and idempotent by request_id, and continues after the MCP connection closes. A later Dataset Head requires another Refresh. If TRACK_SELECTION_REQUIRED, send selected_track_ids once to retain the permitted tracks. Selections cannot rotate until Stop finishes. Poll get_daily_track after retry_after_seconds.
en.retry_daily_track: Retry one blocked DailyTrack; requires tracking:execute, is non-destructive and idempotent by request_id, and may remain blocked when the frozen target still cannot fit. Poll get_daily_track after retry_after_seconds when status becomes active.
en.stop_daily_track: Irreversibly stop one active or blocked DailyTrack; requires the independent tracking:stop scope, is destructive and idempotent by request_id, and does not accept a confirmation token. Poll get_daily_track after retry_after_seconds while status is stopping.
en.list_research_batches: List durable Research Batches newest first with opaque pagination; requires research:read and returns no child Results.
en.get_research_batch: Poll one durable Research Batch with aggregate progress and ordered child run identifiers; requires research:read, embeds no Results, and returns retry_after_seconds while work remains active.
en.cancel_research_batch: Cancel one queued or running Research Batch; requires research:cancel, irreversibly cancels unfinished child work, is idempotent by request_id, and when status is cancelling requires get_research_batch polling after retry_after_seconds until terminal cancelled.
en.submit_research_batch: Atomically submit a Factor Evaluation Batch, single-Alpha Strategy Sweep, or independent_strategies list of complete Strategy Backtests sharing dates and universe. Independent items may mix Formula/Python and Framework/Direct; each owns its applicable neutralization and account configuration. No automatic Alpha-by-configuration combinations. Accepts 1 to 20 caller-keyed items; requires research:execute, is non-destructive, and is idempotent by request_id. Invalid research is a structured rejected outcome with isError=true and actionable issues; after acceptance, poll get_research_batch using retry_after_seconds until terminal.
en.cancel_research_run: Cancel one queued or running ordinary ResearchRun; requires research:cancel, irreversibly prevents a Result, is idempotent by request_id, and when status is cancelling requires calling get_research_run after retry_after_seconds until terminal cancelled.
en.submit_research_run: Submit a fully specified Factor Evaluation or Strategy Backtest, or explicitly rerun an owned Strategy Run/Track with rerun_source and a new request_id. A rerun uses current data and rules; results may differ. It preserves source parameters and records rerun_origin without replacing the source. Track sources require checkpoint_manifest_sha256 from provenance and through_session; they run from the original research start. Source reruns additionally require research:read (Run) or tracking:read (Track). Reading expired holdings does not submit a rerun. All submissions require research:execute, is non-destructive, and is idempotent by request_id. Invalid research returns a structured rejected outcome with isError=true and actionable issues; after acceptance, poll get_research_run using retry_after_seconds until terminal. The accepted receipt is bounded; get_research_run returns the normalized frozen input.

zh-CN.get_research_context: 创建或修改研究时从这里开始。读取当前数据准备情况、编写约束、文档指引和一页研究文件夹。使用 get_authoring_reference 查询完整公式语法和 Python SDK，用 get_alpha_catalog 查找可用字段与函数。约束包含可执行的 Direct/Framework 模板。提交前用 diagnose_research_spec 检查完整配置。将 folders.next_cursor 作为 folder_cursor 获取下一页；folder_limit 默认 20，最多 50。
zh-CN.get_alpha_catalog: 编写公式或读取 Python 历史数据前，查找当前可用 Alpha 字段和函数。kind=fields 或 functions 可分别浏览；query 按标识符、字段 ID 和说明进行不区分大小写的子串搜索；identifiers 精确筛选名称，多项筛选取交集。字段在前、函数在后，分别按标识符排序。合计每页默认 20 项，最多 50 项；用 next_cursor 继续并保持筛选不变。公式使用 identifier，data.history 使用 field_id；语法和 SDK 语义见 get_authoring_reference。
zh-CN.diagnose_alpha_formula: 在 signal 或 exposure 上下文中诊断表达式，不创建研究任务。Exposure 接受常量或公共日频数值表达式，结果须在 0 到 1 之间；不允许使用个股字段、横截面 rank 或账户状态。
zh-CN.diagnose_research_spec: 根据当前数据、表达式依赖和执行预算检查完整研究配置。不创建研究任务，也不预留数据。提交时会独立重新校验；此检查不预留执行容量。
zh-CN.list_research_runs: 查找、过滤或排名当前研究者拥有的研究记录。过滤和数值排序作用于全部匹配记录，然后分页。策略排名请指定 strategy_backtest、succeeded 和排序指标。多个指标条件同时成立，0.20 表示 20%。缺失指标排在末尾，不计入有效名次。结果包含指标摘要、比较区间和股票池；按候选 ID 读取详情。字节预算可能让本页少于 limit 条；需要更多有效条目时保持条件不变并继续 next_cursor。多页是实时视图，不是冻结快照。需要 research:read；读取不会创建或重新运行研究。
zh-CN.get_research_run: 轮询单个持久化研究任务，不内嵌研究结果；需要 research:read 权限，任务仍在进行时可能返回建议的重试间隔。
zh-CN.get_research_run_result: 读取已成功研究任务中一个有界的结果分区；集合分区采用稳定分页，需要 research:read 权限。交易事件分区提供目标、委托、子委托、成交和估值调整，支持日期、证券和父级 ID 筛选，每页最多 50 行。现金使用研究结算金额核对，而非原始名义金额。not_recorded 与已记录但为空的页面不同。daily_holdings_status 列出独立保留单元，不续期。daily_holdings 必须指定 unit_id，支持日期和证券筛选。每页最多扫描八个分区；空页面仍有 next_cursor 时，扫描尚未结束。每次成功读取明细仅为该单元续期七天。expired / not_recorded 与已记录的空账户不同；不会自动重新运行研究。持仓游标始终绑定其原始来源。 大型分区返回 result_page：继续调用本工具，传入 section=result_page、query=原始查询参数、result_cursor=next_result_cursor。按 offset 顺序拼接 json_fragment，核对 checksum_sha256 后再解析完整 JSON。
zh-CN.list_daily_tracks: 按从新到旧的顺序列出持久化每日跟踪，使用稳定的不透明游标分页；需要 tracking:read 权限，仅返回精简摘要。
zh-CN.get_daily_track: 轮询单个持久化每日跟踪的生命周期、进度、可用操作、时间信息、阻塞原因和可用结果分区；需要 tracking:read 权限，不内嵌观测、持仓或检查点。
zh-CN.get_daily_track_result: 从当前不可变检查点读取一个有界的每日跟踪结果分区；观测和初始持仓使用稳定的不透明游标分页，需要 tracking:read 权限。交易事件分区对目标、委托、子委托、成交和估值调整分页，支持日期、证券和父级 ID 筛选，每页最多 50 行。事件游标在刷新前后绑定同一次发布；不传游标重新查询可查看新发布的事件。daily_holdings_status 列出独立保留单元，不续期。daily_holdings 必须指定 unit_id，支持日期和证券筛选。每页最多扫描八个分区；空页面仍有 next_cursor 时，扫描尚未结束。每次成功读取明细仅为该单元续期七天。expired / not_recorded 与已记录的空账户不同；不会自动重新运行研究。持仓游标始终绑定其原始来源。 大型分区返回 result_page：继续调用本工具，传入 section=result_page、query=原始查询参数、result_cursor=next_result_cursor。按 offset 顺序拼接 json_fragment，核对 checksum_sha256 后再解析完整 JSON。
zh-CN.start_daily_track: 从成功的策略回测创建一个持久化每日跟踪；需要 tracking:execute 权限，无破坏性，按 request_id 保证幂等，MCP 连接关闭后仍会继续。来源未成功、不是策略回测、来源重复或活动容量已满均作为状态冲突拒绝。接受后，按 retry_after_seconds 间隔轮询 get_daily_track。
zh-CN.refresh_daily_track: 将活动、落后且空闲的每日跟踪的一次显式推进加入队列，目标为最新可用 Dataset Head；需要 tracking:execute 权限，无破坏性，按 request_id 保证幂等，MCP 连接关闭后仍会继续。之后出现的新 Dataset Head 需要再次刷新。如遇 TRACK_SELECTION_REQUIRED，请提交 selected_track_ids 选择允许继续的跟踪；选定后须等待 Stop 完成才能换选。按 retry_after_seconds 间隔轮询 get_daily_track。
zh-CN.retry_daily_track: 重试一个已阻塞的每日跟踪；需要 tracking:execute 权限，无破坏性，按 request_id 保证幂等，若冻结目标仍无法容纳则可能继续阻塞。状态变为 active 后，按 retry_after_seconds 间隔轮询 get_daily_track。
zh-CN.stop_daily_track: 不可逆地停止一个活动或已阻塞的每日跟踪；需要独立的 tracking:stop 权限，属于破坏性操作，按 request_id 保证幂等，不接受确认令牌。状态为 stopping 时，按 retry_after_seconds 间隔轮询 get_daily_track。
zh-CN.list_research_batches: 按从新到旧的顺序列出持久化研究批次，使用不透明游标分页；需要 research:read 权限，不返回子任务结果。
zh-CN.get_research_batch: 轮询单个持久化研究批次，包含汇总进度及有序的子研究任务标识符；需要 research:read 权限，不内嵌结果，仍有活动任务时返回 retry_after_seconds。
zh-CN.cancel_research_batch: 取消一个排队中或运行中的研究批次；需要 research:cancel 权限，不可逆地取消未完成的子任务，按 request_id 保证幂等。状态为 cancelling 时，按 retry_after_seconds 间隔轮询 get_research_batch，直到终态 cancelled。
zh-CN.submit_research_batch: 原子提交因子评估批次、单 Alpha 策略参数扫描，或共用研究区间和股票池的独立完整策略列表 independent_strategies。独立项可混用公式/Python、Framework/Direct，各自配置适用的中性化和账户；不自动展开 Alpha 与配置组合。每批 1 到 20 项，由调用方提供项目键；需要 research:execute 权限，无破坏性，按 request_id 保证幂等。无效研究返回 isError=true 的结构化 rejected 结果及可修正的问题；接受后按 retry_after_seconds 间隔轮询 get_research_batch，直到终态。
zh-CN.cancel_research_run: 取消一个排队中或运行中的普通研究任务；需要 research:cancel 权限，不可逆地阻止结果生成，按 request_id 保证幂等。状态为 cancelling 时，按 retry_after_seconds 间隔调用 get_research_run，直到终态 cancelled。
zh-CN.submit_research_run: 提交完整配置的因子评估或策略回测，或使用 rerun_source 和新的 request_id 显式重新运行自己拥有的策略研究或跟踪。重新运行使用当前数据和规则，结果可能不同；保留来源参数并记录 rerun_origin，不替换来源。跟踪来源须提供 provenance 中的 checkpoint_manifest_sha256 和 through_session，从原研究起始日期开始。来源重新运行还需要 research:read（研究任务）或 tracking:read（跟踪）权限。读取已过期持仓不会提交重新运行。所有提交均需要 research:execute 权限，无破坏性，按 request_id 保证幂等。无效研究返回 isError=true 的结构化 rejected 结果及可修正的问题；接受后按 retry_after_seconds 间隔轮询 get_research_run，直到终态。accepted 收据保持精简；通过 get_research_run 获取规范化的冻结输入。
zh-CN.get_authoring_reference: 查询当前研究编写契约，无需先准备数据，也不创建研究。topic 可选 workflow、formula、python_sdk、examples。不传 symbol 时返回主题概览和成员索引；传入索引中的精确成员名，读取完整签名、参数、行为、对象字段和示例。未知成员返回 found=false 和索引。编写不熟悉的公式或 Python 前，先读相关条目；用 get_alpha_catalog 查当前可用字段和函数，再用 diagnose_research_spec 检查完整配置。
